findings.title: Timing Attack Vulnerability in API Key Comparison
findings.description: The authentication middleware uses non-constant-time string comparison (apiKey !== expectedKey) which allows timing attacks to extract the API key byte-by-byte. An attacker can measure response times to determine correct characters in the API key.

findings.title: Weak Development Mode Authentication Bypass
findings.description: Lines 16-19 allow unrestricted API access when NODE_ENV is 'development' and no API_KEY is set. This creates a significant security risk if development mode is accidentally enabled in production or if attackers can manipulate environment detection.

findings.title: Multiple Jest-related Dependency Vulnerabilities
findings.description: npm audit found 18 moderate severity vulnerabilities in Jest and related packages, including js-yaml prototype pollution (GHSA-mh29-5h37-fv8m).
findings.remediation: Update Jest to version 25.0.0 or higher to resolve dependency chain vulnerabilities. Run: npm audit fix --force

findings.title: Missing .env.example Template
findings.description: No .env.example file found to guide developers on required environment variables. This can lead to misconfiguration and security issues.
findings.remediation:
Create .env.example file with required variables:

# API Configuration
API_KEY=your-secret-api-key-here
NODE_ENV=development
PORT=3000
